# Zone 1: Anxi (Western Regions & Central Asia) — context-visible only when emperor holds non-capital lands in zone.
oe_cel3_dec_charter_duhu_1 = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_celestial_mandate
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		NOT = { oe_cel3_has_duhu_zone_1 = yes }
		NOT = { AND = { country_exists = c:YGU c:YGU = { is_subject_of = root } } }
		any_owned_location = {
			is_capital = no
			oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = yes
		}
	}
	allow = {
		at_war = no
		gold >= 150
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_cel3_need_4_locs_z1_tt
			any_owned_location = {
				is_capital = no
				oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = yes
				count >= 4
			}
		}
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes
				at_war = no
				gold >= 300
				any_owned_location = {
					is_capital = no
					oe_cel3_loc_in_zone_1 = yes
					count >= 6
				}
			}
			value = 50
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = exterior }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3_dec_charter_duhu_1.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			add_gold = -150
			custom_tooltip = oe_cel3_charter_zone_1_tt
			oe_cel3_charter_zone_1 = yes
		}
	}
}

	potential = {
		is_ai = no
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	}
	allow = {
		always = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_cel3_dec_readout.a
		ai_chance = { value = 100 }
		effect = {
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cel3.90
		}
	}
}
